interactables.text: The [Movie Star], Vivienne Vale, weeps operatically. 'I heard Rudebeak. At [8:00 PM]. I'd know that screech anywhere. He was HERE.'
The [Bird Handler], Petra, holds out an untouched bowl of seed. 'This was his six o'clock snack. [He never misses it]. Never.' You respect a fellow professional.
The [Empty Cage]. The latch is [snapped clean off]. The seed tray is bone dry, and the feathers under the cage have settled flat.
Tucked behind the cage stand, half-hidden by a fern: a small [Wireless Speaker]. A thin [Audio Cable] trails behind the furniture toward the wall.
A film crew camera on a tripod. The red light says [Recording]. It's been on all day. Someone forgot to check if it was aimed at the [cage].
A booklet: 'Phrases We've Taught Rudebeak.' Entries include: 'Hello gorgeous', 'Oscar worthy', and '[Garbage slop]' - the last one furiously crossed out and labeled: '[Maid's fault]'.

localDeductionSentence: Everyone heard the [8:00 PM Squawk] - but the [Broken Latch] and the [Hidden Speaker] under the cage tell a very different story.
